title: Seasonal and Close-In Terms for Room Reservations Room-Type Moves
content:
**Term.** On a Room Reservations move to a room type that sleeps the adults registered, the published room-type differential is raised according to the award season of the arrival night and how close to arrival the move is recorded. When the arrival night is in the peak season and the move is recorded no more than 14 days before arrival, the differential is raised by the close-in multiplier of 1.50; when the arrival night is in the peak season and the move is recorded more than 14 days before arrival, or the arrival night is in the standard season and the move is recorded no more than 14 days before arrival, it is raised by the advance multiplier of 1.25; in every other case the published differential is charged at the standard multiplier of 1.00.

**The inputs.**

- *Award season of the arrival night* — peak, standard or off-peak, as recorded on the reservation at booking.
- *Days before arrival* — calendar days from the date the move is recorded to the arrival date on the reservation.
- *Raised by a multiplier* — the room-type differential for the night is multiplied by the multiplier.

## Multiplier by season and lead time

| Award season of the arrival night | Move recorded 14 days or fewer before arrival | Move recorded 15 days or more before arrival |
|---|---|---|
| Peak | 1.50 | 1.25 |
| Standard | 1.25 | 1.00 |
| Off-peak | 1.00 | 1.00 |

## The 14-day boundary

| Arrival date (hypothetical) | Move recorded | Days before arrival | Peak arrival night | Standard arrival night |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 30 July | 16 July | 14 | 1.50 | 1.25 |
| 30 July | 15 July | 15 | 1.25 | 1.00 |

Exactly 14 days counts as "no more than 14 days".

## Illustration (hypothetical differential of 40.00 per night)

- Peak arrival night, move recorded 9 days before arrival: 40.00 multiplied by 1.50 is 60.00.
- Peak arrival night, move recorded 30 days before arrival: 40.00 multiplied by 1.25 is 50.00.
- Off-peak arrival night, any lead time: 40.00 multiplied by 1.00 is 40.00.
